newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR MONDAY, NOVEMBER 25-THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR MONDAY, NOVEMBER 25-THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5.

text.p: COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, PRESIDENT (0930/0830 GMT) - Interim ruling T-155/96 Stadt Mainz v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of July 1, 1996, on aid granted to the city of Mayence to the management company of the Fort Malakoff Mainz buildings in the form of the sale of a building at too low a price.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-313/94 Graffione: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36 and article 12, paragraph 2(b) of Council directive 89/104/EEC: First Council Directive of December 21, 1988, to approximate the laws of member states relating to trade marks. Lawful marketing of goods covered by a trademark in one member state. Ban on imports to another member state. Toilet paper marketed under the name "Cotonelle". - Judgment C-68/95 T. Port: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 16, paragraphs 3 and 30 of Council regulation 404/93, of February 13, 1993, on the common organisation of the market in bananas. Validity and interpretation of article 19, paragraph 2 of this same regulation. Importer in a particular situation. Granting of an exceptionally limited quota, following application of article 19, paragraph 2 of said regulation. Competent national judicial body having referred to the Court a question as to whether a regulation can prohibit provisional measures. - Opinion C-157/94 Commission v/ the Netherlands: free movement of goods. Non respect. EC treaty articles 30 and 31. National law granting an exclusive import right for electricity. - Opinion C-158/94 Commission v/ Italy: free movement of goods. Non respect. Articles 30, 34 and 37 of EC treaty. National law granting an exclusive import right for electricity within the framework of a commercial monopoly. - Opinion C-159/94 Commission v/ France: free movement of goods. Non respect. EC treaty articles 30, 34 and 37. National legislation granting exclusive import and export rights for electricity and combustible gas. - Opinion C-160/94 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of goods. Non respect. Articles 30, 34 and 37 of EC treaty. National legislation granting exclusive import and export rights for electricity. - Opinion joined cases C-65/95, C-111/95 Shingara: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 9 of Council directive 64/221/EEC of February 25, 1964, for the co-ordination of special measures concerning the movement and residence of foreign nationals which are justified on grounds of public policy, public security or public health. - Opinion C-282/95-P Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (third chamber enlarged), rendered June 27, 1995, in case T-186/94, Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission. Judgment acknowledging the lack of grounds for a ruling on an action for incompetence and rejecting as inadmissible the subsidiary conclusions in annulment. - Oral procedure C-310/95 Road Air: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 132, paragraph 1, 133, paragraph 1 and 134 of EC treaty. Validity of Council decision 86/283 of June 30, 1986, as regards the association of EU overseas countries and territories (PTOM) as well as of Council decision 91/110 of February 27, 1991. Nature of relations between the EU and the PTOM. Free exchange zone or customs union. Imports of unrestricted goods in the Dutch Antilles but originating in a third country. Exemption from customs duty. Applicability. - (1130/1030 GMT) Oral procedure 180/95 Draehmpachl: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 2, paragraph 1, and 3, paragraph 1, of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. National law establishing conditions for rights to damages in cases of discrimination. Employer at fault. Indemnity limited to a sum equivalent to three months salary and to six months salary to be distributed between several workers.

COURT OF JUSTICE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-272/95 Deutsches Milch-Kontor: agriculture. Interpretation of articles 9, 12, 16 and 95 of EC treaty as well as of article 2 of Commission regulation 1624/76 of July 2, 1976, on special measures on aid payments for powdered skimmed milk, altered or processed in foods for animals on the territory of another member state as modified by Commission regulation 1726/79 of July 26, 1979. Inspection measures for product quality and composition. Frequency of controls performed by sample collection. Inspection fees at exporter's expense.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-13/96 Bic Benelux: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, points 1 and 5 of Council directive 83/189/EEC of March 28, 1983, laying down an information procedure in the domain of technical norms and regulations as amended by Council directive 88/182/EEC of March 22, 1988. Notions of "technical specifications" and "technical rules". A distinctive marking of the product indicating either the fact that the product was subject to an ecotax and the sum paid, or the cause of the exemption and the sum on deposit. - Opinion joined cases C-218/96, C-219/96, C-220/96, C-221/96, C-222/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Commission directive 93/105/EEC of November 25, 1993, establishing annex VII D containing the information necessary for the technical dossiers targeted in article 12 of the directive laying down the seventh amendment of Council directive 67/548/EEC. - Oral procedure C-28/96 Fricarnes: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 9, 12 and 95 of the EC treaty and article 33 of Council directive 77/388/EEC: sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Taxes affecting the slaughter or import of porcine, bovine, ovine and caprine meat and the marketing of meat, intended to combat certain diseases in animals.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-167/95 Linthorst, Pouwels en Scheren: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9 of Council directive 77/388/EEC, the sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Offering of a service. Location where service is tendered. Veterinary services. Vets established in a member state and exercising in another member state. - Oral procedure C-61/95 Greece v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission decision 94/871 of December 21, 1994, on the clearance of the accounts presented by Member States in respect of expenditure for 1991 of the EAGGF, Guarantee Section. Milk, olive oil, cotton and tobacco sectors. import

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-268/94 Portugal v/ Council: external relations. - Opinion C-336/94 Dafeki: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-345/95 France v/ Parliament: company law. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure Geotronics v/ Commission: external relations.
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-47/95 Terres Rouges v/ Commission: agriculture.
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-267/95, C-268/95 Merck: membership of new states. - Opinion C-357/95-P ENU v/ Commission: funding.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-246/95 Coen: company law.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-103/95 Reisdorf: taxation. - Opinion C-103/96 Eridania Beghin-Say: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-205/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. - Oral procedure C-258/95 Julius Fillibeck Soehne: taxation. - (0930/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-153/96-P de Rijk v/ Commission: agriculture. - Judgment C-91/96 Commission v/ Greece: agriculture - Oral procedure C-8/96 Locamion: taxation. - (1000/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-136/95 Thibault: social policy.
